originality.rationale: Originality is for the full all-severity superlevel-set probabilities and distinct two-coordinate uniform priors, not the underlying map, convergence, transition threshold or sign-change boundary already in earlier works. Closest open-access primary results and published mathematical records were inspected/queried. Existing threshold/bifurcation theorems do not state the exact severity distribution, whose proof requires an additional discriminant and prior-specific interval measure. This is best-knowledge priority, not independent certification.
residual_risks: An older equivalent severity expression may remain unlocated; short calculations are prone to independent rediscovery.

value.rationale: A complete one-step loss spike severity distribution is a naturally motivated risk statistic for randomly initialized, convergent quartic dynamics, not a restatement of existence threshold. It provides all tail quantiles and exact threshold scaling, demonstrates meaningful sampling-coordinate dependence, and distinguishes loss spikes from sign changes. The invariant is exact and self-contained under two natural priors; no unjustified downstream claim is made.
